title: Register-based study of vericiguat in patients with advanced heart failure: effects on pulmonary vasculopathy, right-sided heart failure and mortality following heart transplantation (VeriHTX)
summary: The impact of elevated pulmonary vascular resistance on right-sided heart failure and mortality following heart transplantation has not yet been sufficiently investigated. This study aims to gather further data on this topic and, in particular, to investigate the extent to which treatment with the heart failure drug vericiguat can lead to an improvement in pulmonary vascular resistance and a reduction in right heart failure and mortality following heart transplantation.
conditions: Pulmonary hypertension in left-sided heart disease

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who underwent a heart transplant between 2016 and 2026 and who underwent right heart catheterisation within 6 months prior to the transplant.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
a. Heart failure with reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF <40%) 
b. Heart failure treatment in accordance with guidelines 
c. Completed heart transplant (HTX) 
d. Classic HTX indication (advanced left heart failure with ≥ 1 episode of cardiac 
decompensation, maximum oxygen uptake achieved in spiroergometry ≤ 14 ml/min/kg; or: support with a left ventricular assist device (LVAD))
e. Regular haemodynamic assessment via right heart catheterisation (RHC) as part of routine HTX preparation (clinical indication!); latest available RHC ≤ 6 months prior to HTX 
f. Pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) ≥ 2 Wood Units (WU) 
g. Follow-up regarding vital status for at least 12 months after HTX
Exclusion criteria:
h. Contraindications for RHC
i. PVR < 2 Wood Units
j. Incomplete heart failure treatment, except in cases of intolerance
